title: SEC0: Backup doesn't retry on SQLITE_BUSY/LOCKED
description:
backup.rs:39 calls Backup::run_to_completion() without handling SQLITE_BUSY or SQLITE_LOCKED errors. These are common when:
- kithd is actively writing to the database
- Another kithctl backup is in progress
- A VACUUM is running

Current behavior: backup fails with opaque rusqlite error message mentioning database is locked.

Expected: Either automatically retry with backoff (since it is a transient error), or emit a helpful message like kithd appears to be running try again in a moment.

Fix: Add exponential backoff retry loop with max 3-5 attempts, or detect BUSY or LOCKED specifically and emit user-friendly guidance.
